Welcome to North 44 Farm

We are a first generation farm in Bend, Oregon specializing in farm-direct deliveries of our premium grass fed and finished lamb, beef, and seasonal poultry.

We believe in being stewards of our land and focus on raising healthy, stress-free animals using regenerative farming practices.

We pride ourselves on a hard day's work that translates into some of the best meat you'll eat. Taste the difference in locally raised, grass fed and finished lamb and beef.

What Drives Us

We believe that good things take time. That animals should always have space to roam and eat a natural, all-grass diet. Our herd is raised with love, respect, and year-round attention, and we know that comes through in our final product.

Our Beef
Grass Fed and Finished Beef in Bend, Oregon 

Just like our lamb, our beef is also pasture-raised and always grass fed and finished. Our cattle graze a network of owned and leased parcels where they are free to graze on the available grasses and legumes. 

CERTIFIED GRASSFED

We are Certified Grass Fed! We are passionately grass-only when it comes to our beef and lamb. No grain finishing here, just pure grass-fed and finished beef from our farm to you. Certified Grassfed by AGW is the only certification and logo in the U.S. and Canada that guarantees food products come from animals fed a 100 percent grass and forage diet, raised outdoors on pasture or range and managed according to the highest welfare and environmental standards on an independent farm. While other grassfed labels exist, none can match the breadth, integrity and transparency that Certified Grassfed by AGW offers.

CERTIFIED ANIMAL WELFARE APPROVED

We are Certified Animal Welfare Approved! The Certified Animal Welfare Approval by AGW is the only label that guarantees animals are raised outdoors on pasture or range for their entire lives on an independent farm using truly sustainable, high-welfare farming practices. It is the only label in the U.S. to require audited, high-welfare production, transport and slaughter practices, and has the single highest impact on consumer purchasing of any food label, according to The Hartman Group.

RAISED REGENERATIVELY

Just like our sheep, we rotationally graze our cows on a large network of leased and owned land. This intensive management allows the animals, the soil, and the pastures to become more resilient and thrive. After years and years of regeneratively managing our pastures, we have seen the difference and can talk for far too long about why taking care of your soil and pasture health is integral to farming in a delicate ecosystem like Central Oregon. 

NO HORMONES. NO ANTIBIOTICS. 

We do not use any hormones at any stage of our animal's lifecycle. On occasion, we will make the choice to use antibiotics to treat a sick animal but that animal is then sold outside of our meat program. 

CUSTOM CUT AND ALWAYS DRY AGED

We work with a highly regarded USDA-inspected meat processing facility to bring you the best-finished product possible. Our beef is always dry-aged for no less than 14 days and often closer to 28 days. This is a big difference from the supermarket standard of "wet-aged" meat. Taste the difference of dry aged, grass fed and finished beef raised with care, hard work, and time. We know you'll love it.

LOCAL DELIVERY INFO
ABOUT N44 LOCAL DELIVERY 
We offer free Local Delivery for any order that meets our $50 minimum. Please scroll down to view the map and list of our delivery areas. All Local Delivery orders are fulfilled on Tuesdays. Orders must be placed before 3:00 pm on Monday to qualify for Tuesday delivery! If you need your order on a specific date that doesn't fall on a Tuesday, please review our Local Pickup page. 

WHERE WE DELIVER

We deliver orders to:

Bend
Redmond
Sisters
Sunriver
Powell Butte
Tumalo 

For those that are not within our delivery zone, we have pickup spots in Redmond and Sisters where your order can be delivered for you to pick up.

WHAT TO EXPECT
Once your order has been placed, you can expect delivery on the next Tuesday. If you would like delivery of your order on a specific Tuesday, feel free to leave us a note at checkout. 
We will pack your order with ice sheets to maintain temperature in transit (all meat is delivered frozen). If you won't be home and want your delivery packed with more ice, just let us know by sending us an email to hello@north44farm.com 
Once the delivery route has begun on Tuesday morning, you will receive an email or text notification letting you know an estimated time of arrival with real-time updates that you can follow. 
We'll text you or send an email notification as soon as your order has been delivered.
Step outside and grab your box of locally raised grass-fed meat and enjoy!
WHAT TIME WILL I RECEIVE MY ORDER?
Your delivery time will vary depending on our route that week. All orders are dispatched on Tuesday mornings. At the time of dispatch, you will get an email or text letting you know an approximate delivery window you can expect your order to arrive by. All orders are packed frozen and delivered with ice sheets to maintain temperature in transit so if you're not home as soon as your package arrives, that's okay! In addition to receiving a delivery time window, you will also receive a notification letting you know when your order has been delivered. 

I DON'T WANT PACKAGING USED IN MY ORDER
We don't use Styrofoam or plastics in our delivery materials and do our best to reduce packaging waste wherever we can. All orders are packaged in recyclable cardboard and have reusable ice sheets. If you would like to further minimize your packaging, here are two options:
 
Leave the cardboard box and ice sheets out for us at your next delivery and we will take them back for reuse. 
Leave a cooler out for us to transfer your order into - a note letting us know that is your preference is much appreciated!

FARM CLUB

Farm Club = North 44 Farm grass fed lamb and beef delivered to your door every month or quarter 

Getting started with the Farm Club is easy! Choose from our three Farm Club box options below, select your box size, meat choices, tell us how you like to cook, how many people are in your household, choose any add ons, and we'll create a custom box just for you!   

The best part is that you have full control with our subscription boxes. If you're not ready for your next order, you can skip months, change the frequency, adjust the quantity and put your order on pause. Subscription boxes are available for Central Oregon delivery and national shipping. Once you complete your initial subscription purchase, you will receive login information to your subscription portal where you can manage everything. Easy peasy!

Boxes are billed on the first of the month and ship on the second Monday of the month with local deliveries fulfilled on Weds. If you order past the cut off date, your subscription will begin on the following month. You have complete control of your subscription, you can pause and skip shipments, change your box size, and cancel your subscription by logging into your account which is generated after check out.
